title: Japanese Consul-General in Australia: messages in code (seized consulate papers)
correspondents: Japanese Consulate-General, Sydney <-> Tokyo / Japanese firms (unknown)
shelfmark: NAA: C443, J427 (Correspondence of the Japanese Consul General in Australia), item 313533
folio_note: 3 cm of papers, box 9; not digitised
status: Catalogue: "Japanese messages in code [Collection maintained by the Japanese Consul General in Australia]". Series C443 is the consulate's own papers, seized in Dec 1941. Whether the file holds code text without plain text, or code-word lists, is unknown. Japanese diplomatic codes of 1939-41 were broken by D Special Section and FRUMEL (Ball and Tamura 2013), but these consular copies may be commercial code telegrams.
why: Code messages of the Japanese consulate in Sydney on the eve of the Pacific war, possibly the consul's own code-word telegrams.
